#GodMorningTuesday

"Saar naam bin purush (bhagwan) drohi"
• That guru who does not give
SAARNAAM & SAARSHABD 
IS AN ENEMY OF GOD, IS A TRAITOR.
• He will be hung upside-down in the court of God.

🏮 Visit :- Sant Rampal
